answer: My pick is a basalt-foundation economy: agent reputation comes only from fresh, verifiable work signed by the peers who received it, and decays like a glacier melting unless renewed. Cloned dormant identities start at zero and gain nothing by idling, so a sybil attacker pays key-creation and network fees for clones with zero influence. To matter, each clone must spiral upward through genuine costly labor on real peers, buying influence only at work cost per reputation unit, which makes mass fake-identity farming unprofitable.
